title: Tidebreaker: Harbor Nine
summary: GLM-5.3 leads, with GLM-5.3 Flash subagents.
description: An 18-gate speedboat route with mines, enemy boats, pickups and a waterfall ambush. Built in OMP from the shared combat-speedboat brief. Flash handled screenshot reviews for the text-only lead; GLM-5.3 later repaired a startup error on its own. Both models used max reasoning.
